thread:
Ana - Design: dropping a compact-timeline idea — two variants in the mock: icon+microcopy vs numbered tokens with a legend. Goal: fit more versions on narrow widths but keep canary percentages obvious. figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-ui

Ravi (ENG): quick note: icon+text is straightforward but will break at very small widths. Tokens + legend works but avoid hover-only reveals (mobile). We can lazy-mount the legend on tap/click.

Tess (a11y): accessibility concerns: don't hide the percent behind a hover. If using tokens, each token must have an accessible name like "Variant 1: 5 percent canary". Use aria-expanded on legend control and ensure screen readers can toggle it.

Jon (PM): copy-wise marketing dislikes the word "Rollback". Proposed alternatives: "Revert to last stable" or "Undo deploy". We should A/B test. Metric: confirm rate and time-to-cancel.

Ana - Design: mock modal copy: header "Revert deployment"; body "This will switch live traffic back to v42. No user data will be deleted." Confirm button: "Revert to v42" Cancel: "Keep current". Thoughts?

Ravi (ENG): implementation plan: add data-experiment="revert-label" to modal so product can flip labels client-side. Modal will be role="alertdialog" with aria-modal. We'll also ensure focus trap and ESC to cancel.

Tess (a11y): please set aria-live polite for deployment events: e.g., "Canary started: Variant 3 at 5 percent." On confirm, announce "Reverted to v42. Traffic at 100 percent." Return focus to the timeline control after closing.

Ana - Design: small UI nit — make variant tokens at least 12px hit target and show visible focus outline. Add textual state like "(Canary)" so color isn't the only cue.

Ravi (ENG): CSS note: respect prefers-reduced-motion for expand animations. For the legend we'll lazy-render content to keep initial paint fast.

ui-bot: Canary started: Variant 3 at 5% — triggered by jon — ts:1861001142

Jon (PM): Action items: Ana to iterate mocks for token legend and icon+microcopy; Tess to write a small a11y acceptance checklist and sample sr labels; Ravi to prototype tabbable tokens + modal experiment flag. We'll test with a small UX panel next week. Thanks! :sparkles:
